source_file: MOCK::Software Testing and Quality Assurance Lab
course_title: Software Testing and Quality Assurance Lab
description: This course covers software testing fundamentals including test case design techniques such as equivalence partitioning, boundary value analysis, and state transition testing; automated testing with Selenium and JUnit; quality assurance standards like ISO 9001 and IEEE 829; defect management with JIRA; performance testing using JMeter; security testing with OWASP ZAP; and regression testing strategies. Students will also explore test automation frameworks, continuous integration practices, and test-driven development (TDD) methodologies.

clos.text: Define test case design techniques such as equivalence partitioning, boundary value analysis, and state transition testing.
Describe automated testing tools like Selenium and JUnit, including their architecture and implementation in Java.
Explain quality assurance standards such as ISO 9001 and IEEE 829, and their role in software development lifecycle.
Apply performance testing tools like JMeter to evaluate system scalability and load handling capabilities.
Implement security testing practices using OWASP ZAP to identify vulnerabilities in web applications.
